blocks.text: BCDA President Joshua M. Bingcang has claimed that PAX Silica will operate under Philippine laws. That claim cannot stand because PAX Silica, as it is being pushed, already proceeds in violation of the laws that are supposed to govern it. It is not a project that follows the law and then builds. It is a project that builds first, promises compliance later and asks the Filipino people to accept the consequences as inevitable. The four grounds below show why the claim of legality is false.
